name: cdbg0-inspect
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, cm = app.controllerManager; cm.nearColliders(0, 0, 1); const out = {}; for (const [id, s] of Object.entries(C.LANDMARK_SITES || {})) { const r = Math.max(s.w || 50, s.d || 50); const cs = cm.colliders.filter((c) => c.polygon && c.maxX > s.x - r && c.minX < s.x + r && c.maxZ > s.z - r && c.minZ < s.z + r); const area = (p) => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { const q = p[(i + 1) % p.length]; a += p[i].x * q.z - q.x * p[i].z; } return Math.round(a / 2); }; const ground = cs.filter((c) => c.minY === undefined); out[id] = { ground: ground.map((c) => [c.polygon.length, area(c.polygon), Math.round(c.maxY * 10) / 10]), bands: cs.length - ground.length, boxes: cm.colliders.filter((c) => !c.polygon && c.obb && Math.abs(c.obb.cx - s.x) < 1 && Math.abs(c.obb.cz - s.z) < 1).length }; } console.log('[inspect] ' + JSON.stringify(out)); })()

name: cdbg4-yonge-dundas
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP; app.selectMode('person'); const pl = app.subway.entrances && app.subway.entrances.pylons || []; let best = pl[0]; for (const p of pl) if (Math.hypot(p.x, p.z - 120) < Math.hypot(best.x, best.z - 120)) best = p; app.teleportTo(best.x + 2.5, best.z + 1.5, Math.PI); const e = app.controllerManager.getActiveEntity(); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [e.position.x + 7, e.position.y + 6, e.position.z + 8], look: [best.x, best.y + 0.5, best.z], fov: 55 }); })()
